original_prompt: Create an Ansible playbook that installs the OpenTelemetry Collector (binary or yum/apt repository), configures it to receive OTLP on port 4317 and export to a remote endpoint, and starts it as a systemd service.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: Ansible playbook (YAML)

Task: Create an Ansible playbook that installs the OpenTelemetry Collector (binary or yum/apt repository), configures it to receive OTLP on port 4317 and export to a remote endpoint, and starts it as a systemd service.

Output only the Ansible playbook (YAML) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
```yaml
---
- name: Install and configure OpenTelemetry Collector
  hosts: all
  become: true
  vars:
    otelcol_version: "0.88.0"
    otelcol_arch: "linux_amd64"
    otelcol_user: "otelcol"
    otelcol_group: "otelcol"
    otelcol_binary_url: "https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector-releases/releases/download/v{{ otelcol_version }}/otelcol_{{ otelcol_version }}_{{ otelcol_arch }}.tar.gz"
    otelcol_config_dir: "/etc/otelcol"
    otelcol_binary_path: "/usr/local/bin/otelcol"
    remote_endpoint: "otel-collector.example.com:4317"
  tasks:
    - name: Create otelcol system group
      ansible.builtin.group:
        name: "{{ otelcol_group }}"
        system: true

    - name: Create otelcol system user
      ansible.builtin.user:
        name: "{{ otelcol_user }}"
        group: "{{ otelcol_group }}"
        system: true
        shell: /sbin/nologin
        createhome: false

    - name: Ensure config directory exists
      ansible.builtin.file:
        path: "{{ otelcol_config_dir }}"
        state: directory
        owner: "{{ otelcol_user }}"
        group: "{{ otelcol_group }}"
        mode: "0750"

    - name: Download and extract OpenTelemetry Collector binary
      ansible.builtin.unarchive:
        src: "{{ otelcol_binary_url }}"
        dest: /tmp
        remote_src: true
        creates: "/tmp/otelcol"

    - name: Install OpenTelemetry Collector binary
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        src: "/tmp/otelcol"
        dest: "{{ otelcol_binary_path }}"
        owner: root
        group: root
        mode: "0755"
        remote_src: true

    - name: Create OpenTelemetry Collector configuration
      ansible.builtin.template:
        src: otelcol-config.yaml.j2
        dest: "{{ otelcol_config_dir }}/config.yaml"
        owner: "{{ otelcol_user }}"
        group: "{{ otelcol_group }}"
        mode: "0640"
      notify: Restart otelcol

    - name: Create systemd service unit
      ansible.builtin.template:
        src: otelcol.service.j2
        dest: /etc/systemd/system/otelcol.service
        owner: root
        group: root
        mode: "0644"
      notify: Reload systemd and restart otelcol

    - name: Enable and start otelcol service
      ansible.builtin.systemd:
        name: otelcol
        enabled: true
        state: started
        daemon_reload: true

  handlers:
    - name: Restart otelcol
      ansible.builtin.systemd:
        name: otelcol
        state: restarted

    - name: Reload systemd and restart otelcol
      ansible.builtin.systemd:
        daemon_reload: true
        name: otelcol
        state: restarted
```
